settings.name: REDIRECT_FROM
settings.description: **Path to redirect from:** The path that will be redirected.

settings.name: REDIRECT_TO
settings.description: **Destination URL:** The target URL where visitors will be redirected. Leave empty to disable redirection.

settings.name: REDIRECT_TO_REQUEST_URI
settings.description: **Preserve Path:** When set to `yes`, appends the original request URI to the destination URL.

settings.name: REDIRECT_TO_STATUS_CODE
settings.description: **HTTP Status Code:** The HTTP status code to use for redirection. Options: `301`, `302`, `303`, `307`, or `308`.
